palette: the lead card's own material (lead_card_art.py's VOIDKIN, take A), mirrored to face it (research's pick, 13:35); the skulls, the arrow, the shards and CR's tab as before

card.note: the Shade's and the elite's card; the keeper keeps TR5's BossBar. Mirrored: its top left corner square, its ends leaning right (the right end's top 16.8 in from the card's right). The top row starts 4 in, the gem and arrow end clear of the right end. The health light fills the plate's slot exactly: from 24 to 37 down, its ends 5 in from the plate's, leaning right as the plate does: its top left 14.6 from the card's left, its foot right 7 from the card's right. One colour along it, as the lead's (AR12); it still fills from its left

levels.note: each over the plate's indigo, top and foot; every level wears the dark outline of AR44's plain take

Skull.tint: the tier's colour (ImageColor3); its rim stays dark under any tint
Skull.use: the difficulty skull: drawn 16 points high in an 18 point box, its centre the anchor. On a Shade's and an elite's card at 15 high (the box 16.9), a keeper's at 17 (19.1); its centre 14 from the card's left, on the level's row. The faint tier at ImageTransparency 0.45; the others solid

EdgeArrow.use: the type edge, right of the type gem, 9 points high: up as drawn; down at Rotation 180

CardRankEdge.use: an elite's and a keeper's edge, in place of PanelEdge: brass, the kit panel's own cut, sliced like it (Cut 12 each side). Its own colours, never tinted
CardRankEdge.unused: the upright cut, replaced by B on the slant (research, 12:32)

RankHornLeft.use: a horn's root (the anchor) on the card's top edge, 14 in from its left corner. A keeper's at 14 high, as drawn; an elite's at 11 (scale 11/14, its anchor with it). Over the card, under nothing
RankHornLeft.unused: the thin horns, replaced by the shards (research's must-fix, 12:32)

RankHornRight.use: the left horn mirrored: its root 14 in from the card's right corner
RankHornRight.unused: the thin horns, replaced by the shards (research's must-fix, 12:32)

RankCrest.use: a keeper's crest: three brass shards, the anchor on the card's top edge at its middle
RankCrest.unused: the keeper keeps TR5's BossBar (the director, 12:24)

PhaseNotch.use: a keeper's phase: the anchor on the bar's top edge, at 1/3 and 2/3 of its length. Drawn for the keeper's 15 point bar with its slant (0.45 of its height); the dark cut through the light, the brass point above
PhaseNotch.unused: the keeper keeps TR5's BossBar (the director, 12:24)

CrTab.use: CR's gold tab, drawn for a 24 point number: its plate's left, top, width and height in the box. It scales with the number (a 14 point number takes 14/24). "CR" is the game's text over it: dark ink #4A2A08, bold, 0.62 of the number's size, centred on the plate; the number right of it in ivory #F7F1E3, upright and wide apart, with AR44's plain take's outline and shadow

CardSlantFill.use: the target card's plate in the lead card's own material (its CardPlate): the Voidkin's indigo from #35286B at its top to #171033 at its foot, a pale line under its top edge, a dark line inside its rim, and the health's slot, dark with a pale lower lip. Mirrored to face the lead's card: its top left corner square, its ends leaning right, 0.4 of its height across. Its own colours, never tinted, ImageTransparency 0. The health light sits in the slot (`slot`: its four corners from the card's top left, top left first). Sliced at Cut (left, top, right, foot), its slanted ends inside the end slices: drawn at its own height, it stretches along only. The card's box is the image less Pad on every side.

CardSlantEdge.tint: the Voidkin's lavender, #DCCBFF (Config.UIKit.Systems.Voidkin.Colour), as the lead's CardPlateRim
CardSlantEdge.use: a Shade's rim over the plate, 1.5 points, as the lead card's. Sliced at Cut (left, top, right, foot), its slanted ends inside the end slices: drawn at its own height, it stretches along only. The card's box is the image less Pad on every side.

CardSlantRankEdge.use: an elite's rim, in place of CardSlantEdge: brass, lit along its left end, its own colours, never tinted. Sliced at Cut (left, top, right, foot), its slanted ends inside the end slices: drawn at its own height, it stretches along only. The card's box is the image less Pad on every side.

RankShardLeft.use: an elite's mark: a solid brass shard about 6 points tall, leaning out. Its root (the anchor) on the card's top edge, 14 in from its top left corner. Its own colours; never scaled down

RankShardRight.use: the left shard mirrored: its root 14 in from where the top edge ends (the card's width less the plate's lean, 16.8, then 14)
